title: Passage and Compass
author: Juniper Sandoval
blurb: Zephyrine Hartwell, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
